# 關於運行 LVHI Searchlight 穿梭機的提示 - 發電機組的最佳 [bold]目標功率[/bold] (kW) 為 [color=#a4885c]24 [bold]kW[/bold][/color]。 If you've added additional machines, check shuttle [bold]APC units[/bold] to monitor the shuttle's power draw and adjust the generator's [bold]Target Power[/bold] accordingly. For more general information on the power grid and other life support systems, refer to the [textlink="Power" link="Power"] guidebook article and the [textlink="Preflight Checklist" link="PreflightChecklist"/]. - 太空梭內設有數個按鈕：黃黑邊框的按鈕用來控制舷窗百葉窗；灰邊框的按鈕用來切換推進器與陀螺儀（位於工程艙內）；紅黑邊框的按鈕則用來控制太空行走艙門。
- 有關醫療照護的基礎知識，請參閱 [textlink="醫師" link="醫師"]。 - 有關化學混合的基本知識，請參閱 [textlink="Chemist" link="Chemist"] 及 [textlink="化學品清單" link="Chemicals"]。 - For the basics of [bold]shuttle piloting[/bold], refer to [textlink="Piloting" link="Piloting"] and [textlink="Sector Topology" link="SectorTopology"/]. - As a Captain of a Nanotrasen vessel, you have the authority to hire, fire, demote, or promote crew members at will, refer to [textlink="Hiring" link="Hiring"] for more information.
